# Synthetic Data & Data-Centric AI

**Improve models by improving their data: find label errors, label less, augment, generate synthetic tables and LLM training sets, and know when synthetic data backfires.**

Level: **Intermediate** · 12 steps · 4h 58m of video · Prerequisites: [Machine Learning](machine-learning.md). [Deep Learning](deep-learning.md) helps for the GAN and VAE step; [Fine-Tuning & Reasoning Models](fine-tuning.md) helps for the LLM steps.

## Build it

- Run cleanlab on a public text classification dataset, review the 50 most suspicious labels by hand, and report how many were truly wrong.
- Generate a synthetic copy of a tabular dataset with SDV, then compare a model trained on synthetic data with one trained on real data.
- Create 200 QA pairs from your own notes with synthetic-data-kit, filter out the bad ones, and publish the dataset on Hugging Face.
